messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: Viscous friction depends on the velocity of the object. The force also relies on a damping coefficient. This coefficient captures fluid properties and surface area. One must include this term when air resistance is significant. Significant drag occurs at high speeds or in thick fluids.
